name: Unstable SMP FFA [MINECRAFT PVP!]
desc:
An Unstable SMP simulator where you play as the actual characters from the Unstable Universe, with real Minecraft Java 1.21.11 combat.

⚔️ FREE FOR ALL
Spawn as a character with their real gear and trims. Spear lunges, mace smashes, elytra and rockets, wind charges, pearls, tridents and TNT cart PvP, all like Java 1.21.11. Plus Duels, a Practice Dummy and Juggernaut Events.

🛡️ SIMULATOR
Take on the armies of the Unstable SMP, from NULL and The Law to Cindercrest and the Kingdom of Unstable. Play solo or with a party of up to 10, against up to 100 soldiers that fight back and heal.

🗺️ THREE ARENAS
Northern Council, MinuteTech's End Base and FlameFrags & Wemmbu's 2v1000, swapping every 15 minutes.

👤 PLAY AS
28 characters, like Wemmbu, ParrotX2, SpokeIsHere, FlameFrags and ManePear, or unlock The Wraith to play invisible.

🎮 PC, phone and controller, with rebindable controls.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Mojang or the Unstable Universe.
